items.headline: Dry bulk freight rates hold near multi-year highs
items.summary: The Baltic Dry Index sat around 3,430 points this week, up sharply over the past month and roughly 53% year-on-year, as Pacific weather disruptions and strong export demand keep Capesize tonnage tight.

items.headline: EMIR reconciliation deadline arrives for legacy fields
items.summary: A new EMIR reconciliation start date takes effect for fields previously governed by a two-year transition window, while the requirement to reconcile the underlying index name field has been dropped.

items.headline: Molecule buys Trilogy to merge physical and financial gas
items.summary: ETRM vendor Molecule acquired Trilogy Energy Solutions, combining its API-first financial trading platform with Trilogy's physical gas gathering, nomination and scheduling tools into one operating system.

items.headline: Commodity trade finance market forecast to grow fast
items.summary: A new market report projects the commodity trade finance sector expanding from about $59.7 billion in 2026 to $81.45 billion by 2030, driven by blockchain settlement and real-time risk monitoring adoption, per GlobeNewswire.
